result.brief: 在纵向电子病历序列上系统比较三种 JEPA 潜空间预测目标与 MLM，发现 JEPA 训练稳定但下游性能不及 MLM，并分析目标尺寸与异质性的影响。
result.reason: Studies JEPA latent-prediction objectives for EHR sequence representation; JEPA-style self-supervised representation learning is directly relevant, but domain is clinical EHR rather than visual/video.
